(rule! (lambda (g)
  ;; Find the hollow colour-2 frame and preserve its bounding-box dimensions.
  (define bb (bbox-of-cells (find-color g 2)))
  (define r0 (first bb))
  (define c0 (second bb))
  (define r1 (third bb))
  (define c1 (fourth bb))
  (define oh (+ 1 (- r1 r0)))
  (define ow (+ 1 (- c1 c0)))
  ;; The non-background, non-frame rectangle inside the border is the key.
  (define interior
    (for*/list ([r (in-range (+ r0 1) r1)]
                [c (in-range (+ c0 1) c1)])
      (list r c)))
  (define key-cells
    (filter (lambda (p)
      (let ((v (at g (first p) (second p))))
        (and (not (= v 0)) (not (= v 2)))))
      interior))
  (define kbb (bbox-of-cells key-cells))
  (define kr0 (first kbb))
  (define kc0 (second kbb))
  (define kr1 (third kbb))
  (define kc1 (fourth kbb))
  (define kh (+ 1 (- kr1 kr0)))
  (define kw (+ 1 (- kc1 kc0)))
  ;; Replicate key rows and columns independently to fill the frame interior.
  (define rscale (quotient (- oh 2) kh))
  (define cscale (quotient (- ow 2) kw))
  (grid-from-fn oh ow
    (lambda (r c)
      (if (or (= r 0) (= c 0) (= r (- oh 1)) (= c (- ow 1)))
          2
          (at g
              (+ kr0 (quotient (- r 1) rscale))
              (+ kc0 (quotient (- c 1) cscale))))))))
